blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Presiding Officer Francis Escudero said the Senate impeachment court will retain in its records the term “respondent-accused,” which Vice President Sara Duterte’s lawyers have used when referring to her during the trial. The clarification came after House prosecutor and Akbayan party-list Rep. Chel Diokno questioned the use of the term “accused,” saying Duterte should instead be referred to as a “respondent” because an impeachment proceeding is not criminal in nature./dp READ: Watch: Sara Duterte impeacment trial | Sept. 23, 2026...
